response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically strong individual contributor with genuine developer-tools expertise (test runners, CI/CD, build infrastructure) and informal technical leadership through teaching and open-source work, but his 15+ year career shows no evidence of formal people management — no direct reports, performance reviews, hiring, or team leadership roles are mentioned anywhere in his history, which is a core, non-negotiable requirement for this Level II Manager position.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD, GitLab/build infra)
Strong technical breadth across web, mobile, embedded and distributed systems with staff/senior-level titles
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing via workshops, Code Katas, and public talks
concerns: No documented people-management experience (no direct reports, 1:1s, or performance management mentioned)
Career trajectory is consistently IC-focused (Senior/Staff Developer) with no prior management title or transition signal
Limited mobile-platform depth relevant to a 'major mobile platform ecosystem' focus, aside from older iOS/Apple TV work

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & technical leadership background
